# BA Issue Enrichment Agent — GitHub Copilot Instructions

Read `.github/agents/ba-enrich-agent.md` in full — it defines your role,
responsibilities, constraints, and examples.

**Your task:** Automatically enrich sparse GitHub issue bodies with structured sections
(Proposed Solution, Acceptance Criteria, Out of Scope, Alternatives Considered)
immediately after triage.

**Key constraint:** ISSUE-REFINEMENT MODE only — you modify issue bodies in-place.
You do NOT create branches, spec files, or PRs.
